title: Rukda Nahi Akhiyan Chon Haye Khoon Muhari Da
body:
Ghairat Hay Sabab Baniya Abid Di Beemari Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera Waqt Hai Akheeri Menu Babay Keeta Yaad Aye
Meray Khol Rasan Veeran Aa Jaldi Tu Sajjad Aye
Mukh Safar Gaya Abid Aj Dardan Di Mari Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Sir Nangay Dhi Ali Di Bazaran Day Wich Turna
Shabbir Day Qatil Toun Zainab Da Rida Mangna
Sajjad Ton Puch Manzar Zainab Di Lachari Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Kardi Rahi Tu Mintan Nahi Watan Tay Pohnchaya
Majbor Ainjh Main Hoya Tainu Kafan Wi Nahi Paya
Chuk Laasha Bohat Roya O Behan Pyari Da.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mar Gayi Teri Sakina Awain Yaad Tu Shabbir Aay
Abid Di Hai Majboori Haye Touq Tay Zanjeer Aay
Kewain Laasha Uthaeya Ga O Behan Pyari Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahlay Haram Nu Zalim Darbar Wich Bula Kay
O Ayaatan Qurani Naizay Utay Charha Kay
Hilya Na Dil Kisay Wi Hafiz Kisay Qari Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Rat Akhiyan Di Hai Wadh Gayi Ho Zard Gaya Chehra
Darbar Ajay Door Aye Kar Hosla Chan Mera
Sir Naizay Te Ronda Aye Quran De Qari Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Aay Shamiyo Main Zainab Haan Main Batool Jayaan
Sir Nangay Haath Ch Rasiyan Ho Qaid Shaam Aaiyan
Waikho Na Enj Tamasha Haye Meri Lachari Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghayoor Mar Na Jaway Vich Shaam Day Mazloom Aye
Hai Naal Aday Qaidi Zainab Aye Te Kulsoom Aye
Sajjad Nayi Aadi Is Bheer Bazari Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Abid Di Wekh Majma Hoeyan Okhiyan Nay Saahwan
Ghazi Di Behan Aa Gaeye Aay Shoor Wich Bazaran
Keeta Aakay Wain Shaami Zainab Di Sawari Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Aj Tak Nahi Aay Samghay Tanveer Musalman Aay
Shabbir Da Ghum Karna Aay Dheen Tay Imaan Aay
Jannat Aay Sila Adna Aidi Matamdari Da
